people.name: Adah
people.line: Wife of Lamech; mother of Jabal and Jubal

people.name: Jabal
people.line: Son of Lamech; father of nomadic herdsmen.

translations.web: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
translations.bsb: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock.
translations.kjv: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
translations.asv: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle.
